title: Decision tree from an optional output
statement: For a natural number $n$, associate to an optional decision tree on the $n$ coordinates a decision tree hypothesis with leaves labeled by signs in $\{\pm1\}$. If no tree is supplied, the hypothesis is the constant leaf labeled $+1$; if a tree is supplied, retain its query coordinates and recursively convert its two child trees.
hypotheses_covered: The optional tree, when present, is a decision tree on those coordinates with sign-valued leaves
